diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all four rollouts because the lone decision-maker always chose 'approved' for the formulary status and 'satellite emergency department' for the stock location, which aligns with the PF1 fact that the poison-center protocol changes the approval to 'approved' and the stock location to 'satellite emergency department'. This indicates a structural leak where the model can easily infer these values without needing the hidden information.

C1.why: The poison-center protocol changes the approval from an optional formulary request to an approved medication and changes the stock location from an unspecified hospital location to the satellite emergency department.
